layout.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE refined high-fidelity website DESIGN REFERENCE for the first screen of the Russian handmade wooden gifts shop vamknam.by. Input image is the CURRENT live website, a reference for existing identity, exact header and content. User asks to art-direct this hero beautifully using human visual judgment. The current hero is too shallow, the keyholder and hooks are chopped at the bottom, the picture has a hard vertical edge, the typography is cramped. Improve those issues decisively. Keep the existing top header design, logo, all its links, phone, Telegram and cart unchanged. Design only the HERO and the start of the 'Хиты сезона' section below it; do not redesign the rest of the store. Canvas 1440 wide desktop website, no device frame or browser chrome. Overall warm ivory (#fcf8ef), dark walnut text, caramel accents. Sophisticated but friendly artisanal editorial style, no generic SaaS aesthetic, no excessive badges or fake claims. Layout: generous centered content width around 1180, hero about 460 pixels tall with 44px outer top/bottom spacing. A coherent elegant 2-column composition: left readable heading and short description, strong single CTA, right a beautifully lit product photograph of ONE complete light birch keyholder with an arching leaf branch, horizontal wooden plank, five metal hooks and a hanging key bunch; the complete object, including hooks and keys, must fit entirely inside the photo. Photo should be a deliberate self-contained elegant softly rounded rectangle, perhaps with a subtly arched top, not a background stretched behind text. Text hierarchy and spacing must be professional. Calm cohesive ivory and warm beige color palette, balanced whitespace, tactile wood grain and soft light. Headline text exactly: 'Создаём то, что\nне купишь в магазине.' Description: 'Авторские ключницы, копилки и панели из дерева,\nсделанные с душой и вниманием к деталям.' Primary button exactly 'Смотреть работы' with a simple arrow. Optional understated small eyebrow 'СОЗДАНО В МАСТЕРСКОЙ' and tiny line beneath CTA 'Лазерная резка · Персональная гравировка'. Keep copy minimal. Below the hero, show a tasteful 'Хиты сезона' heading and the tops of the four existing product cards to demonstrate visual continuity. Preserve the current season products and prices. This is ONE complete visual layout reference only, never an asset sheet. No individual elements from this UI mockup will be cropped or extracted for use; the product photo will be generated separately. Do not add stars, fake ratings or numbers, testimonials, sale badges, new logos or decorations. Produce a considered beautiful complete composition with crisp Russian typography.

photo.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE standalone photographic website asset, NOT a UI mockup. Input image is a design direction reference ONLY: reproduce the beautiful light birch keyholder and the softly lit warm beige plaster wall shown in its hero photograph, but output ONLY a clean product photograph with ONE complete product in the scene. The single object is a handmade wall-mounted light birch plywood keyholder: a beautiful broad arching branch of thirteen pointed laser-cut leaves growing upward from a rectangular horizontal wooden rail, five small antique brass hooks along rail, a single bunch of two metal house keys with a small brown leather fob hanging from the center hook. Keys are attached to the product. All leaf tips, entire rail, all five hooks, keyring, leather fob and complete key tips MUST be entirely visible with generous 10-12 percent clear wall margins at TOP, LEFT, RIGHT and BOTTOM. The complete product including hanging keys occupies around 75 percent of frame width and 78 percent of frame height. Camera straight-on, centered, product sharp, realistic tactile honey-pale birch grain and darker laser-cut edges, refined professional editorial product photography. Warm creamy beige plaster wall, gentle afternoon sunlight from upper left, soft natural shadows behind object and very subtle diffuse leaf shadows at upper left. Rectangular LANDSCAPE 4:3 photograph. The image itself has NO arch, NO border and NO rounded corners: the website will add framing with CSS. No table, no flowers, no vases, no plant, no jars, no additional separate objects, no text, no logos, no typography, no website, no UI, no collage, no watermark. Keep the entire complete keyholder comfortably within image edges; do not zoom in.
photo.use: Один товар, отдельная генерация, самостоятельный файл.
